current_control_relation: First-party recovery enumerates the descendant work set, excludes stopped/closed/finished/differently-owned/live-elsewhere work, rebinds eligible unfinished children and resumes their original pending commitments rather than replacing them.

experiment: GAIA validation pass@1, Smolagent baseline versus Smolagent + SMAS
disturbance: During ongoing multi-agent execution, live agent-to-agent, agent-to-tool and agent-to-memory interactions can enter explicit-error, inefficient-loop or excessive-observation states that threaten current task regulation.
current_control_relation: SupervisorAgent wraps live interactions, applies an LLM-free risk filter, builds global/local task-and-trace context when triggered, selects an approve/guidance/correction/verification action and returns the intervention into the continuing MAS operation.
mixed_function_caveat: The full SMAS action repertoire includes verification-like intervention in addition to current-control guidance, correction and observation purification. The aggregate base-versus-SMAS result therefore demonstrates capability of the composed supervised organization but is not claimed as an isolated S3-only causal effect.
ownership_caveat: The SupervisorAgent relation is added around the base MAS. The result must not be attributed as native S3 capability of Smolagent, AWorld, OAgents or another wrapped system by association.
provenance_limitation: This is a first-party-reported published result from the pinned SupervisorAgent repository and ICLR 2026 paper. Opensiro did not execute or reproduce the benchmark.
vsm_interpretation: At the declared composed SMAS boundary, SupervisorAgent performs whole-system inside-and-now regulation: it observes current interaction state, selects a corrective/control intervention and returns that intervention into subsequent operation. That makes the published base-versus-SMAS result direct composed S3 capability evidence. Because the supervisor is externally composed around the base MAS and the intervention repertoire is mixed, this observation is non-canonical and cannot select a canonical S3 primary baseline.
